set.body:
Outcome

Turn the two slices into the sole forward development path.

Acceptance

- Prototype duplicates, temporary conversions, unsafe constructors, and public next or legacy namespaces are deleted.
- Current examples demonstrate the unified vocabulary.
- An acceptance report maps every constitutional law to executable evidence.
- New method work is prohibited on the old RoiAnalysis architecture.
set.title: P4.2: remove vertical-slice prototypes and record architecture acceptance
